name: runner-board
description: A pane that shows linear-runner batches: each batch's issues at their stage, with time and tokens, and how the batches follow from one another

python.title: Python
python.description: The Python (3.10 or newer) that runs the runner: a program on the PATH, or a path (~/ is your home).

runner.title: Runner entry point
runner.description: runner.py of a linear-runner checkout (~/ is your home). A relative path is taken from this plugin's folder: the default is the checkout this plugin is part of.

home.title: Runner home
home.description: The runner's private configuration home, whose batches/ folder holds the batch files (~/ is your home). Left at its default, $LINEAR_RUNNER_HOME is used when it is set, as the runner does.
